title: Chapter 13 — The Raid
description: Felix comes back. Somebody comes with him. Ivie is watching.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Friday. Felix comes back for his girls with a bus and two boys. Officer Grace comes back with four officers in a borrowed Hilux and no siren.

beats.speaker: officerGrace
beats.text: NAPTIP! Nobody move! (Felix moves. Of course he moves.)

won.toast: Felix is face-down in the gutter. Officer Grace is reading him his rights, slowly, with pleasure.

beats.speaker: officerGrace
beats.text: He got over the fence. (She sits on the kerb.) But the bus, the passports, the "contracts", I have them. That is twelve girls who don't go to Libya next week, Madam. Twelve.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Friday night. Felix's boys come over the back fence with machetes and a message: nobody embarrasses Oga Felix.

variants.text: Friday night. You gave Felix his bag back. Felix's boys come over the back fence to collect "interest".

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Kokoro is awake. Head of security does not sleep on Fridays. He meets the first boy at the fence with the broom handle he has carried since his promotion.

beats.speaker: kokoro
beats.text: Mama, stand behind me. No. Stand next to me. I have seen your left hook.

won.toast: Kokoro finally wakes up. Together you chase them as far as the Front Stop.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Dawn. Felix's bus is at the gate. Five girls with small bags. Blessing is not on it. Blessing is gone: out of the back window, over the fence, into the morning.

variants.text: Dawn. Felix's bus is at the gate. Five girls with small bags. Kemi refuses to get on. Felix's boy grabs her arm. She bites him and runs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then the sirens. Not Bassey's. NAPTIP. Somebody called them. You will never know who. You will spend years wondering if it was Ivie.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ivie is at the gate. She took a danfo from Ikorodu by herself. She has heard. Everybody has heard.

beats.speaker: ivie
beats.text: They said your name on Wahala FM, Mummy. (She doesn't come in.) They said "trafficking".

beats.speaker: ivie
beats.text: They said your name on Wahala FM, Mummy. They said you helped NAPTIP catch the Italy man. (She hugs you. She hasn't hugged you like this since primary school.) Mummy, is it true?

beats.speaker: ivie
beats.text: They said there was a fight here, Mummy. (She looks at the broken glass, the girls, the stairs.) I want to know everything. Today. Not later.

options.text: "I am closing this place. We will make it a real kitchen. With you."
"This is what pays your fees, Ivie. It will continue."
"Go back to school, my love. Mummy will handle it."

beats.title: The Raid
beats.summary: Something happened on South Street that people will tell their children about. Whether they tell it with your name as the hero is up to you now.
